Create New Case

Record a new confidential social welfare case — including historical records from previous years.

Case Information
Historical Records: You can encode cases from previous years. The Record / Case Year is independent of the current date, so old cases can be entered without changing the current system date. Existing case numbers will remain permanent and continuous.
Client / Child Information
Case Assignment: The assigned social worker can be changed later by an authorized CSWDO Officer/Admin if a social worker resigns, transfers, is reassigned, or the case needs to be transferred. The system will preserve the previous assignment in the case history and audit log.
